criteria.text: The board shows every recorded grout batch in one list on the page.
criteria.note: One list sits under the header with all three batches in it, one line each — B-1041 · sanded · charcoal, B-1042 · unsanded · alabaster, B-1043 · epoxy · slate.

criteria.text: A new batch can be added from the board itself, without leaving the page.
criteria.note: The add row is right on the board — a 'new batch code' input with an ADD BATCH button beside it, so a batch goes in without ever leaving the page.

criteria.text: The board names itself in a header so the tiler knows what he is looking at.
criteria.note: An orange band across the top reads GROUT TRACKER — the board names itself, just as your drawing has it.

criteria.text: The batch list is the first thing under the header.
criteria.note: The list is the first thing below the header — header ends at y=51, the list starts at y=71 directly beneath it, with nothing between them.

criteria.text: An ADD BATCH button sits to the right of the input.
criteria.note: ADD BATCH sits to the right of the input — the input runs from x=20, and the button is out at x=1293, on the same row.

criteria.text: A status line beneath the add row shows the current mix ratio.
criteria.note: Your drawing has an orange mix-ratio line ('MIX RATIO 3:1 · 2 BATCHES OPEN') sitting under the add row. It isn't there at all — below the add row the page drops straight to the grey 'grout tracker · sandbox build' footer.
Nothing on screen can settle this, but your own suite covers it and it passes.

criteria.text: The export writes valid CSV with a header row.
criteria.note: The suite is green, but the two csv lines in it test a parser handling quoted commas and trimming whitespace — neither one checks that the export WRITES a valid CSV with a header row. Nothing in the run speaks to this criterion, and no screen shows it, so I could not check it.

gaps.title: the mix-ratio status line
gaps.expected: an orange mix-ratio line beneath the add row
gaps.saw: nothing there — below the add row the page goes straight to the grey footer

alsoChecked: The ADD button is teal (rgb(90,166,184)); your drawing doesn't say what colour it should be, so I'm treating that as the builder's call.
There's a grey footer reading 'grout tracker · sandbox build' at the bottom; the drawing says nothing about a footer, so that's the builder's call too.
No console errors on the page.
summary: Captain, the board runs and the heart of it is here: an orange GROUT TRACKER header, all three batches in one list directly under it, and an input with ADD BATCH to its right — all matching your drawing, and your own tests confirm the batches survive a restart. One thing your drawing asks for is missing: the orange mix-ratio line under the add row isn't there — the page drops straight to the footer. And I couldn't confirm the CSV export writes a header row: the green suite tests a csv parser, not the export itself, so that one stays unchecked.
